title: Choose the visual world for the rjot landing page
question: The roll assigned the marked-up printout. Keep it, take the pick or an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Marked-up Printout
options.lineage: laser printouts marked up with fluorescent highlighters at a desk
options.thesis: The page is a stack of real printouts you mark up; every highlighted passage lifts off the paper into rjot.
materials: laser-printed paper with print headers and page numbers
options.viewport: A printed AI chat transcript fills the screen; a yellow stroke drags across one reply, ⇧ ⇧ prints in the margin, and the marked line drops into a live rjot window pinned at right. Download sits in the print header.
options.risk: If the strokes read as CSS bars it is a gimmick; ink must be drawn, uneven, multiplied over the type.

raised.raise: Wildstyle blackbook: every stroke draws in sequence as one marker pass, never a fade-in.
VU meter bridge: captured notes land with mass, a damped overshoot like a needle settling.
Airport wayfinding: each fluoro ink means one thing only, the note's color label, never decoration.

options.label: Shift, Twice
options.lineage: keycap set catalogs and keyboard spec sheets
options.thesis: The mechanism is a key; the page is a keycap catalog where the Shift key is the product.
materials: PBT keycap plastic with dye-sub legends
options.viewport: Two monumental Shift keycaps you can press, or that press when you tap your real Shift twice, and the app window catches the result.
options.risk: Keyboard-enthusiast imagery is a familiar dev-tool look; it needs real keycap rendering to rise above it.

options.label: Terminal Yellow Wayfinding
options.thesis: Capture as a route: Selection → ⇧ ⇧ → Notes, signed in monumental yellow bands.
options.viewport: One yellow band across the top: ‘Selected text  ⇧ ⇧  Notes →’ at gate-number scale, the app window down the concourse.
options.case: Holds product clarity (the gesture reads as a route) but builders don't recognize themselves in a terminal.
options.risk: Reads as transit pastiche if the sign grammar is applied to everything.

options.label: Wildstyle Blackbook
options.thesis: The name worked up in marker until it's barely readable.
options.viewport: rjot as an interlocking marker piece.
options.case: Loses both axes: illegible by design, and not the audience's world.
options.kept: Strokes drawn in sequence, one marker pass at a time.

options.label: VU Meter Bridge
options.thesis: A row of needles that leans into the red together.
options.viewport: A row of meters, one per capture.
options.case: Loses both axes: rjot has no signal level to meter.
options.kept: Motion with mass: a damped overshoot when a note lands.

options.label: Algorave Source Floor
options.thesis: Projected code that edits the room.
options.viewport: A live code buffer as the stage.
options.case: Loses both axes: neon on black is the dev-tool rut, and rjot is not code.
options.kept: Change previewed before it happens: the stroke shows before the capture.

options.label: Daylight Section
options.thesis: Light moving through rooms over a day.
options.viewport: A building section with a moving beam.
options.case: Loses both axes: no relation to keeping text.
options.kept: Tabular timestamps pinned to every moment.

options.label: Coiled Earth Tower
options.thesis: A slow ascending record of courses.
options.kept: Each capture adds one course to a visible, growing record.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark developer-tool page: headline, app screenshot, feature grid, download.
canonCard.viewport: Centered headline over the app window, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other Mac utility page by design.
